title: Confess and Believe
question: What does Paul say saving faith looks like from the outside?
blurb: A mouth and a heart, named together. See how the surrounding verses fill it out.

nodes.content: What does Paul say saving faith looks like from the outside?

nodes.verseText: that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
For with your heart you believe and are justified, and with your mouth you confess and are saved.
for, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God—
They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, you and your household.”
